recipes.title: Steam
recipes.description: Scarica e installa il client Steam con le correzioni note per Wine su macOS.
recipes.notes: I giochi DirectX 9 e molti indie girano bene. Con Wine «puro» su macOS i giochi DirectX 11/12 spesso no: servono D3DMetal o DXVK (CrossOver, Game Porting Toolkit). Se la finestra di Steam resta nera, chiudila e riavvia Steam dalla bottiglia.
recipes.description_en: Downloads and installs the Steam client with the known fixes for Wine on macOS.
recipes.notes_en: DirectX 9 games and many indie games run well. With plain Wine on macOS, DirectX 11/12 games often don't: they need D3DMetal or DXVK (CrossOver, Game Porting Toolkit). If the Steam window stays black, close it and launch Steam again from the bottle.

recipes.title: Giochi classici
recipes.description: Per giochi DirectX 9 e precedenti installati da CD/GOG: librerie DirectX, audio XACT e font.
recipes.notes: Se un vecchio gioco non parte, prova a impostare Windows XP o 7 in Configurazione Wine.
recipes.description_en: For DirectX 9 and older games installed from CD/GOG: DirectX libraries, XACT audio and fonts.
recipes.notes_en: If an old game doesn't start, try setting Windows XP or 7 in Wine Configuration.

recipes.title: Applicazioni
recipes.description: Per programmi da ufficio e utility: runtime Visual C++ 2015–2022, GDI+ e font Microsoft.
recipes.description_en: For office programs and utilities: Visual C++ 2015–2022 runtimes, GDI+ and Microsoft fonts.

recipes.title: Applicazioni .NET
recipes.description: Installa .NET Framework 4.8 per i programmi che lo richiedono.
recipes.notes: L'installazione di .NET 4.8 richiede parecchi minuti: è normale che sembri ferma.
recipes.description_en: Installs .NET Framework 4.8 for programs that need it.
recipes.notes_en: Installing .NET 4.8 takes quite a few minutes: it's normal for it to look stuck.
